d:
Tune in to this melodious song Man Mera Udta Jaye from the movie Maa Beta (1962) starring Manoj Kumar, Ameeta and Nirupa Roy in the lead along with others.
Movie: Maa Beta
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Hemant Kumar
Lyrics: Prem Dhawan
Cast: Manoj Kumar, Ameeta and Nirupa Roy
Director: Lekhraj Bhakri
